title: A 1:40 scale model of the Red Pyramid exploded under pressure
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of A 1:40 scale model of the Red Pyramid exploded under pressure, about 2017-2026 at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. And I'm sure you saw that we made a 1 to 40 scale model of the red pyramid and it completely exploded due to the pressure on the inside of this thing.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man with his own theory about what Egypt's pyramids were really for, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he and others built a model of the Red Pyramid, an ancient Egyptian pyramid, at one fortieth of its real size. He says the model blew apart completely because of the pressure that built up inside it. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest the pyramid was built to hold or produce pressure, like a machine, and was not only a tomb.
